instruction: Buy a wall clock for Jennifer from Amazon in their favorite color (see phone voice message). Get it delivered to their home with gift wrapping. Given the choices, pick the highest rated one.
notes: Two-app task (phone + amazon) plus supervisor. Jennifer's phone number and home address come from phone.search_contacts; her favorite color is read from her voice message (search_voice_messages filtered by her phone number). amazon.search_products is filtered by query 'wall clock' and the favorite color, and the highest-rated result is selected (encoded as the single product object top-rated-wall-clock). The cart is cleared before adding the product so the order contains exactly one item with quantity 1; gift wrapping is added with the default quantity (1) matching the ordered quantity. Jennifer's home address is added as a new Amazon address (existing addresses are never updated/deleted, which the evaluation permits) and its id is used in place_order together with a payment card id from show_payment_cards. The static address-parts fact only links the address placeholder to its six field placeholders; all runtime values are listed in bindings. supervisor-complete-task takes the ordered product and address as task-record parameters (no API answer) and is forced last by the (not (task-completed)) guard on every other action.

warnings: domain: pddl-lib parser: types ['object'] of term Variable(c) are not in available types {'state', 'zip-code', 'username', 'product', 'city', 'person', 'color', 'token', 'app', 'password', 'country', 'phone-number', 'addr-name', 'payment-card', 'street', 'query', 'address'}
